title: Useful for a nursery.
text: Useful for a nursery.. This is a pretty lattice hamper. If you have teenage boys, this might not be the best hamper for them. However, because of the size (small), I think it will definitely work in a nursery or playroom. It can hold small clothes (infant and toddlers) or toys. If you use it as a toy box, you can teach your child to “clean-up” while singing the “clean-up song”. This hamper collapses and has two handles, making it easy to move anywhere. It can fit in the laundry-room, corner or closet. And finally, this hamper is coated with something that makes it mold resistant and leak-proof.
